title: The Authentic Power Guidelines: Series Introduction
fullTitle: Soul Feast #66: The Authentic Power Guidelines: Series Introduction

promo.text: Your journey to Authentic Power begins here. Download your copy of the Authentic Power Guidelines today .

description: A profound evolutionary shift is reshaping humanity, and in this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav opens a new multi-part series dedicated entirely to the Authentic Power Guidelines – the clearest, most practical tools he and his spiritual partner, Linda Francis, ever created. Gary begins by describing the breathtaking speed at which a new multisensory consciousness is emerging: a leap unfolding across just three generations, compared to the hundreds of thousands of years defined by the old five-sensory perception. He explains how this new awareness expands our understanding of who we are, why we are here, and how our choices create meaning and purpose.
Gary then deepens the conversation by clarifying the stark contrast between:
External power – the old pursuit of control and manipulation, now obsolete and destructive – and authentic power , the new evolutionary requirement.

Through vivid examples, he shows how multisensory perception is opening us to non-physical reality, to the soul, and to a new way of relating to ourselves and others . He also introduces the origin story of the Authentic Power Guidelines, crafted by Linda, whose brilliance and heart shaped their simplicity and transformative impact.

In just a few sentences, Gary offers the essential takeaway: Authentic power is no longer optional – it is the path forward for anyone committed to harmony, love, clarity, and meaning. This series will guide listeners step-by-step into understanding and applying these guidelines in everyday life.
What You’ll Discover in ThisSoul Feast:

(00:02) — Why the Authentic Power Guidelines are essential in a rapidly changing human consciousness (01:12) — How multisensory perception transforms our understanding of who we are and why we’re here (03:42) — The breathtaking speed of the new consciousness and the limitations of the old five-sensory world (09:07) — Why external power no longer works – and now produces only violence and destruction (11:26) — How interacting “soul-to-soul” reshapes relationships and dissolves surface-level judgments (14:25) — The origin of the Authentic Power Guidelines and why Linda’s creation became their most practical tool
(17:49) — Where to find the Authentic Power Guidelines and how this series will explore them step-by-step

Take a quiet moment with your notebook – your “crutch” for learning to walk upright in spiritual growth – and write down what you imagine the Authentic Power Guidelines might be. What steps would help a person create authentic power? How would you organize them? List any ideas that arise. Then revisit your notes before the next Soul Feast, where Gary will reveal the actual guidelines and how to apply them as part of your spiritual evolution.
